items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We were on WOW. I was the first one to sing 'All of Me' on the radio. Scotty was the vocalist so he would pick the tunes.

ctx.x: Vi. Like Vivian and like your wife's name. Vi. My mother and myself were staying in her home on 27th Street, in Omaha. Scotty the guitarist, Dr. Scott's son, who was a heck of a guitarist and a singer, was staying across the street. At that particular time Vi was married to Jimmy Jones—that was the trombone player that eventually came to New York and worked for Noble Sissel at the Diamond Horseshoe on bass.
